# Specimen log API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Records followed over time for a specimen set, such as temperature, pH or slice health.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/specimenlog/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `specimenlog` (detail, create, update), `specimenlogs` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `specimen_set` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Entry schemas:** `type` selects a [SpecimenLog type](/api/schemas/specimenlog/); each log entry is validated against it.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [SpecimenLog types](/api/schemas/specimenlog/) **[required]** |
| `specimen_set` | [`specimenset`](/api/stem/specimenset/) id **[required]** |
| `target_specimens` | list of [`specimen`](/api/stem/specimen/) ids. Specific specimens within the specimen set targeted by this log. Leave empty when the log applies to the whole specimen set. |
| `description` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `protocol` | [`protocol`](/api/personal_attributes/protocol/) id; nullable |
| `updated_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `created_at` | datetime **[read-only]**; nullable |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimenlog', load_all=True)
records = resp['specimenlogs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('specimenlog', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.specimenlogs;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "specimenlogs": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "type": "BathSolution",
            "specimen_set": "<specimenset-id>",
            "target_specimens": [
                "<specimen-id>"
            ],
            "description": "",
            "protocol": "<protocol-id>",
            "updated_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "created_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenlog', data={"type": "BathSolution", "specimen_set": "<specimenset-id>"})
record = resp.json()['specimenlog']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'BathSolution', 'specimen_set', '<specimenset-id>'), 'specimenlog');
record = created.specimenlog;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('specimenlog', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['specimenlog']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('specimenlog', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.specimenlog;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json

        "type": "BathSolution",

            "<specimen-id>"
        ],
        "description": "",

        "updated_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
        "created_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",

    }

```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('specimenlog', id='<id>', data={"description": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'description', 'new value'), 'specimenlog', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/specimenlog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('specimenlog', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab

```
